methods.evidence: Delivers a message into the session, which Claude reads on its next turn and acts on; the write to the transport is the only acknowledgement, so delivery is not steering and not processing
A reverse request carrying request_id, tool_name, description and input_preview for a tool call the session is waiting on; answering it runs or refuses that call
Answers the pending request named by request_id with allow or deny, which runs or refuses the tool call

qualification_note: Qualified against Claude Code 2.1.278 (npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code), whose macOS arm64 executable is sha256 bd245662fb8a0e321b3bf133e930371d6563c387527885f30b2613aef3ba14d6, and the Channels reference at code.claude.com/docs/en/channels-reference, read 2026-09-20; all three notification names are in that executable. Every message on this surface is a notification with no id member, so the correlation identifier is params.request_id. The decision destination answers channel.permission-request with channel.permission, which repeats the request's own params.request_id and carries a params.behavior of allow or deny. The table sends nothing; where no host carries the answer, the approval is answered in the terminal. The bridge's host contract is core's kr-hook forwarder at core e2f867b3, verified by core's tests against a stand-in application, not a live Claude Code. Volatile forwarding is untested. fixtures/frames.json pins the evidence; docs/qualification-notes.md records each check.
